uncertainties.title: Mode-neutral movement, interaction timing, and nondeterminism
uncertainties.question: For each reachable Semantic Mode, what exact mode-neutral state transitions, PAL timing bounds, input conflicts, rate limits, generic interaction boundaries, and legal player-observable stochastic outcomes apply? Geometry Identity and object-conditioned predicates are excluded.
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Complete two cold-start proof traces for each reachable mode-neutral deterministic obligation and 100 stratified PAL trials for each reachable player-observable stochastic branch. Defer Geometry Identity, object-conditioned interaction and restart-placement predicates to UNC-0002, and inventory identity and capacity predicates to UNC-0003.

uncertainties.title: Object, vehicle, and world behavior semantics
uncertainties.question: Which Geometry Identities correspond to each player-facing object and vehicle, and how do state flags govern entry, collision, visibility, portals, weapons, and transitions?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Prove each of the eight object-conditioned predicate families recorded in object-semantics-coverage.json: object entry eligibility, collision, portal transitions, visibility, weapon behaviour, object-conditioned interaction, restart placement, and take/drop eligibility. Each family needs its own equivalence partition over Geometry Identities with a completeness argument. The enterable inventory and its Handler-Equivalence Class assignment are verified; per-member runtime entry and the remaining families are outstanding. Inventory identity and capacity remain UNC-0003, and the mode-neutral action, conflict, and timing matrix remains UNC-0001.

uncertainties.title: Inventory, economy, mission, and progression tables
uncertainties.question: What are the complete item identities, capacities, transaction values, mission preconditions, rewards, faction effects, and persistent state transitions?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Decode the relevant pointer/state tables and corroborate every discovered transaction and mission transition through reachable proof traces.

uncertainties.title: Message boundaries and trigger associations
uncertainties.question: What is the complete message identity set, exact restricted wording, composition grammar, trigger association, ordering, and dismissal behavior?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Decode message fragments and composition tables from conditioned RAM, then capture every trigger and dismissal path in the running Reference Build.

uncertainties.title: Audio inventory and SID timing

uncertainties.nextExperiment: Run unwarped dump-plus-WAV traces for startup, movement, weapon, interaction, mission, failure, and ending cues and reconcile them with decoded SID dispatch code.

uncertainties.title: C64 save/load behavior
uncertainties.question: Does this PRG preserve all save slots and media behaviors, and which meaningful state fields and future outcomes survive a disk round trip?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Execute writable, write-protected, missing, and invalid D64 cold starts; test slots 0-9, overwrite, and independent-process future-state equivalence.

uncertainties.title: Complete escape routes and meaningful quirks
uncertainties.question: How many endings and materially distinct viable routes exist, and which unusual solutions or quirks materially affect them?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Decode every terminal-state and escape dispatch branch, then reproduce each route from legal state with end-to-end journey traces.

uncertainties.title: Retail C64 corroboration
uncertainties.question: Which startup, message, save, ending, or unusual behavior differs between the supplied crack and preservation-grade retail C64 media?
uncertainties.nextExperiment: Acquire qualified preservation-grade retail C64 media and compare every crack-sensitive trace and decoded table.

uncertainties.title: Geometry comparison review bookkeeping
uncertainties.question: Why does the merged geometry baseline retain a pending manual-review decision although issue #7 is closed?

resolution.answer: The pending decision was stale bookkeeping. The maintainer approved the four digest-bound restricted comparison reports, and the tracked geometry baseline records that approval without changing Geometry Identities.
